'''2012 US Nationals Day 2 Kevin Shannon DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
